assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original illustrative beauty website catalogue photo, not real client work.
Scene/backdrop: only the skin immediately surrounding one eye; no other environment.
Subject: ONE anatomically credible adult woman's open almond-shaped hazel-brown eye; warm light-medium skin with authentic visible pores, natural lower lashes.
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end salon macro photography, natural and unretouched texture, crisp black upper lashes.
Composition/framing: 3:2 LANDSCAPE image, ideally 1536x1024. Eye horizontally centered and filling about 80 percent of frame. Front-on almost-level camera. Whole inner and outer canthus, lash roots and ALL lash tips in frame. Tiny edge of natural brown eyebrow permitted. Eye ONLY: no full face, no nose, mouth, hair or shoulders.
Lighting/mood: clean neutral soft daylight, gentle even exposure, no dramatic color grading.
Constraints: no mascara, clumps, eyeliner, strip-lash band or solid plastic lash wall. No tools, tape, in-image words, logos, watermarks, collage, split panel or before/after layout. Generate one original standalone photo.
Primary request: Lash lift on ONLY the woman's natural upper lashes. Neatly separated fine individual shafts with obvious upward lift and visible curved shape, modest natural density, slightly varying natural lengths. NO lash extensions, NO additions or fans, NO extravagant length. The lash fringe must look far less dense than any extension set, clearly natural and airy, not a glamour false-lash look.
